does: Adds one AI score into another with a multiplier: ors the flags and merges the per-entity entries, scaling their values by the weight.

evidence.says: ors +0 and +4 of the source into the target, grows the target array at +0x20 and walks the 0x28-byte source entries; the float third argument scales
A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 47 places
